settings.naming.title: Naming and files
settings.naming.holdingTitle: Deleted and replaced files wait in .holyarrs-replaced inside their Library folder, then are removed for good.
settings.naming.holdingHint: Deleted files wait in .holyarrs-replaced first; 0 keeps them
settings.naming.musicScanLimit: Artist folders read per music scan
settings.naming.musicScanLimitHint: Lower because MusicBrainz allows one lookup a second
settings.naming.minFree: Always leave this much free space (MB)
settings.naming.minFreeHint: Imports stop below this. Minimum 100 MB.
settings.naming.skipCheckHint: For disks that misreport free space
settings.naming.filePatternHint: {Words} fill in per movie; empty ones drop out
settings.naming.folderPatternHint: New movies only; existing folders keep their names
settings.naming.addToFile: Add {word} to the file name pattern
settings.naming.colon: A colon in a name becomes
settings.naming.colonHint: Windows and many shares can't store colons
settings.naming.illegal: Other characters a disk cannot hold
settings.naming.showFolderHint: New shows only; existing folders keep their names
settings.naming.episodePatternHint: {episode} gives S01E02, or S01E02-E03 for a file holding two episodes.
settings.naming.seeError: See the error under Movie names
settings.naming.addToEpisode: Add {word} to the episode file name pattern
settings.naming.specialsHint: A plain name, such as Specials or Season 00.
settings.naming.daily: For shows ordered by air day
settings.naming.dailyHint: Used for talk shows and news, whose episodes are known by date.
settings.naming.anime: For shows ordered by running number
settings.naming.animeHint: Used for shows whose episodes are counted from 1 across every season.
settings.naming.multiHint: How the episode numbers of a two-episode file are written.
settings.naming.airDayHint: How the date is written in names of shows ordered by air day.
settings.naming.digitsHint: Short numbers get leading zeros up to this many digits.
settings.naming.artistFolderTitle: Folders of artists you already have keep their names.
settings.naming.artistFolderHint: New artists only; {artist_sort} gives Beatles, The
settings.naming.albumFolderHint: Must hold {album}. {edition} gives the Pressing's note, such as deluxe.
settings.naming.addToTrack: Add {word} to the track file name pattern
settings.naming.multiDisc: Track file name on an album of more than one disc
settings.naming.multiDiscHint: Must hold {disc} and {track} (2-03). With a folder for each disc the track pattern is used inside it.
settings.naming.readTags: Read a track's own tags when its name is not enough
settings.naming.readTagsHint: FLAC and MP3 only, and only to tell which track a file is (title, track and disc numbers) when its name leaves it open. Tags are never changed.
settings.naming.rename: Rename files when they are imported
settings.naming.renameHint: Existing files rename only from Rename files
